==Walkthrough==
*Speak to [[Gantineux]] at {{Location|Windurst Waters|map=North|E-10}}.
*Travel to {{Location|The Eldieme Necropolis}}.
*Find the [[???]] on one of four braziers on Map 2: I-10, I-7, M-6, or D-5.
*Touch the [[???]].
**The attempt usually fails and can very rarely report success; this does not affect the quest outcome.
*Return to [[Gantineux]], then deliver his letter to [[Eperdur]] in {{Location|Northern San d'Oria|M-7}}.
